prose: Frank Castle is an inner-dimensional explorer and psychedelic lightworker with a YouTube channel called Frankie Fearless. In this episode we talk about Frank's journey from Hip-Hop artist to neo-shamanic healer, after injury required him to put away his old career and self-initiate a transformation into something more.
ext: We have a fun conversation about the superhero archetype as seen in comics and movies, looking at the positive and dark sides within modern depictions of the illustrated Übermensch (Super Men). We also explore the spiritual world of deities and demons residing within the collective unconscious.
